questions.q: Per the lesson, what is the recruiter screen primarily focused on?
options: Fit, logistics, and work authorization — not a technical evaluation
A deep SQL coding exam
Negotiating final salary on the spot
Reviewing your college transcript line by line
questions.explain: The lesson describes the recruiter screen as non-technical, focused on fit and logistics, though it notes a candidate can still be filtered out at this stage.

questions.q: According to the lesson's role-flavor table, what does a privacy/compliance-focused governance role emphasize?
options: Classification, regulation such as GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA, and access governance
Exclusively graphic design skills
Writing marketing copy
Managing a company's physical office security
questions.explain: The lesson's table lists classification, named regulations, and access governance as the privacy/compliance flavor's emphasis.

questions.q: Which lesson in this course does the governance interview landscape lesson point to for direct SQL and data quality practice?
options: Lesson 26
Lesson 1
Lesson 35
There is no such lesson referenced
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly states Lesson 26 practices the technical/data quality screen directly.

questions.q: What does the lesson say is one of the underlying things interviewers evaluate across nearly every round?
options: Whether you can work with people who don't report to you, since governance runs mostly through influence
Whether you can type faster than 80 words per minute
Whether you have memorized every regulation's exact legal text verbatim
Whether you own a specific brand of laptop
questions.explain: The lesson lists working through influence rather than authority as a core thing interviewers are evaluating.

questions.q: In the lesson's suggested three-week preparation plan, what is Week 1 focused on?
options: Resume, LinkedIn, and portfolio polish, plus drafting a timed 90-second capstone pitch
Taking a vacation before starting any preparation
Only memorizing SQL syntax with no other activity
Negotiating a final offer
questions.explain: The lesson's plan assigns resume/LinkedIn/portfolio polish and the 90-second pitch specifically to Week 1.
